text_block_list.text: December has come...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And the holidays are twenty-five days
away.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Trainer. There is something I wish for you
to see.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
She excitedly holds a thin, flat box out
to me.
There's a festive scene on its lid.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
A countdown calendar. Have you heard
of them
before?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
December is an important month for a
lot of
people in Germany, with all sorts
of festivities
going on. Counting down
the days is one of them.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
The small doors are each labeled with a
date, and
one is to be opened each day
until the big
celebration at the end of
the month.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
As for the contents... Please open
today's door
and see for yourself.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I do as she asks and pull open the flap,
revealing
a small golden parcel inside it.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
That has chocolate in it. There are
twenty-five
days' worth of
confectionaries within this
calendar.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Impressive, I know. Getting to see what
is inside
each day is quite thrilling.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I would be most happy if this countdown
calendar
gave you something small to
look forward to
every day.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
We can't. There are not enough sweets
for both
of us. I made this specifically for
you.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
The chocolates and sweets inside, yes.
Each one
is unique.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list: You put so much work into this...

text_block_list.text: That's because it's a special time of year.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Though that is not the only reason.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list: Let me help you with something too.

text_block_list.text:
No, it's all right. My holiday plan was set
in
motion three months ago, so there's
no need to
assist me.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I will prepare food and cake as well. I
hope you
look forward to it.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I know she said I didn't need to help,
but I still
feel bad for not doing anything
in return. I should
get her a present, at
the very least.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I received the same wreath. The message
affixed
to it was different, however.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
"May the joy you felt at your debut
continue
throughout your racing career."
That is the wish
mine is imbued with.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
There are twenty-five days until the big

celebration. I take out my phone to
search for
craft classes I can attend
between shifts at work.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Эйсин Флэш keeps working diligently
throughout
the month as the big day
draws nearer.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant... Pant...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Thud!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Time to begin.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Эйсин Флэш drags in a massive tree that's
easily
over two meters tall like it's a
toothpick.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I was able to acquire a Nordmann fir,
which I
intend to start decorating
immediately.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
It will be a grand centerpiece by the
twenty-fifth,
so please look forward to
it.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer. Have you opened today's
countdown
calendar door?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list: Yes, I got some gummy candies!

text_block_list.text:
In the shape of teddy bears, yes? I had a
lot of
fun preparing them as chances to
make gummy
candy are few and far
between.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Now you must excuse me. I still have
work to do.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: On another day...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
A five-kilogram goose, please. I will pick
it up on
the day of.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
You got it! I'll get the best one I can just
for you!
text_block_list.name: Butcher

text_block_list.text: Thank you.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Next is the supermarket. I need four
kilograms of
potatoes, four heads of
purple cabbage, two
kilograms of
apples...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
And so, I watch over her as she balances
holiday
preparations and her training.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
December is drawing to an end. Eishin
Flash and I
open the last door on the
countdown calendar
together.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
That's right. It's delicious and sweet
since it's
made of marzipan.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
With that, all the doors have been
opened. Well
done.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list: Thanks! That was a lot of fun!

text_block_list.text:
I'm glad. I also enjoyed your report each
morning
before our training sessions.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Now, regarding our schedule for the
party...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
We will chat about it while partaking in
a meal.
That is all.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I'm surprised by the schedule's sparse
details,
especially knowing how hard she
worked to get
everything ready.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Yes, that is all. I only prepared food and

decorations.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: I'll bring the food over now.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Is this... a wreath?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I give Эйсин Флэш the wreath I've
painstakingly
put together over the past
month.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list:
It's not much compared to the one from your
parents, but...

text_block_list.text: Trainer, did you make this by hand?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Just for me?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list:
YЭпизод I made it in hopes that you'll always be
happy, Flash.

text_block_list.text: Oh...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
May you always find happiness wherever
life
takes you...
text_block_list.name: Flash's Father

text_block_list.text: H-huh?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Apologies. I-I'm just so overwhelmed
with joy...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
This holiday is meant to be spent with
family and
holds a special place in my
heart.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
However, I did not have the mental
leeway to
celebrate properly last year.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
And... I didn't believe I had anyone to
celebrate it
with.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I thought it would be better to forgo it if
thinking
about my family was only going
to make me feel
lonely...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
But in reality, there was someone
watching over
me like family the entire
time.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
That's why I put on a party this year. I
wanted to
celebrate properly and use it
to thank that
special person.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
And yet, I'm the one who received a
wonderful
present in the process.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list: You've given me so much more.

text_block_list.text: No, it is you who—
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. There will be no end at this rate.
The dishes
are getting cold, so why
don't we begin the
party?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
What would you like first? There is carp
too, if
you'd like.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I anticipated that reaction. This is called
"Karpfen
blau," and it is a lovely
seasonal dish.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
It seems carp is not a common ingredient
in
Japan. Falcon was most surprised
when I...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I was quite innocent and believed Santa
Claus
existed beyond a shadow of a
doubt.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Thus, I made a plan to capture him and
set it into
motion... But all I ended up
doing was catching
my parents
completely off guard.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
After seeing how much Эйсин Флэш loves
the
festive season, I wanted to find
another way to
make it even more
special for her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And so, while we're enjoying the food
and
chatting together...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Hello, hellooo! ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Hi, you two! Happy Holidays! ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Falcon? What are you doing here?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: It's not just me! C'mon in, everyone!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Happy Holidays, Flash! ♪
text_block_list.name: Каррен Тян

text_block_list.text:
Happy Holidays! Wow, look at all this
food! I've
gotta take a pic of this!
text_block_list.name: Тосэн Джордан

text_block_list.text:
Curren, Jordan. And everyone else... I
wasn't
expecting you all.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Oh, just to be clear, we're not here to
crash your
quiet party or anything.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Buuut! We do want you to experience
the loud
and rowdy end-of-year parties
we like to hold in
Japan! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Эйсин Флэш might have thought she
didn't have
anyone to spend the
holidays with last year, but
that belief of
hers isn't true anymore.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: You're right... It seems I do.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I'm glad I'm here at this academy right
now,
spending the holidays with you.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
She looks just like a child with her
bright,
beaming smile.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Эйсин Флэш tells me even more stories
while I
enjoy her cooking.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
